name: What defines a 'luxury home' in the Miami-Dade or Broward County market for a first-time buyer?

mainEntity.name: What defines a 'luxury home' in the Miami-Dade or Broward County market for a first-time buyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Miami-Dade and Broward Counties, a luxury home typically transcends a specific price point, encompassing properties with high-end finishes, premium amenities like private docks or smart home technology, desirable locations, and often architectural significance. For first-time luxury buyers, the definition also includes the lifestyle and exclusivity associated with the property. Kelby Contreras specializes in understanding these nuanced features and matching them to your preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: A luxury home in South Florida is defined by high-end finishes, premium amenities, desirable locations, and architectural significance, beyond just price.
